answer: Since the haven quote is stored with the verdict, the cedar audit and the tee log can recheck it, and a forged measurement is provable after the fact. The enclave must match the published build to within 89% of its measurement, so a modified runtime is rejected before its answer is read. A farm cannot swap in a cheaper pipeline and keep the badge, as the wander comparison fails on the first divergent byte and the operator burns for hardware it cannot use. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
